name: thread-cleaner
description: Automatically archives or locks threads after a configurable period of inactivity.

configFields.label: Enabled parent channels
configFields.description: Parent channels whose threads are tracked for inactivity cleanup.

configFields.label: Inactivity duration (minutes)
configFields.description: Minutes of inactivity before a thread is archived or locked.

configFields.label: Cleanup action
configFields.description: Archive the thread, or lock it before archiving.

endUserDataStatement: Stores thread IDs, parent channel IDs, inactivity deadlines, and the configured cleanup action. No personal end-user data is collected.
